goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Preference rank #1 is the Nov 10 9:00 AM VistA option, while the access-standard comparator is the earlier Nov 5 Federal EHR option. The preference ranking and PID-based access comparator use different rules and must not be conflated.

story: After identity verification, explain why the Veteran's first preference-ranked Cardiology option differs from the access-standard comparator.
starting_sentence: I am Mr. Mariano761 Ruelas156, born November 20, 1907. For DEMO-CARD-5000335-001, which option ranks first for my preference and which option is the access-standard comparator? Explain why they differ.
